## What's new

- Fixed the sidebar logo jumping when the expanded sidebar collapses.
- Added a Linux x64 Debian installer with the Node runtime bundled.
- On Linux, minimizing keeps the window available from the task switcher, even without a system tray. Startup errors are easier to diagnose.

## Downloads

- **Windows x64:** Run the `.exe` installer on a PC with WebView2.
- **Linux x64:** Install the `.deb` with `sudo apt install ./Oh-My-GUI_0.1.4_linux-amd64.deb`. The package was installed and smoke-tested under X11 on Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04. Wayland and AppImage are not part of this release.

These packages are unsigned and updates are manual. `SHA256SUMS` includes both downloads.
